description: Index of NAVIG Blocks — installable, executable, verifiable outcomes ('apply an outcome'). Canonical form is the <id>/BLOCK.md folder. During the preview, blocks install first-party only (from navig-run/registry); entries without a marketplace block are free. Install: `navig apply <id>` (auto-installs) or `navig install add block:navig-run/registry/blocks/<id>`.

blocks.description: Install the Wombie small-talk & identity persona pack into the active space.
Build the SteamPipe app_build VDF and upload a build via a pre-authenticated steamcmd. Does NOT set a branch live (see steam-release-live).
blocks.verify_summary: steamcmd app_status reports the app after upload

blocks.description: Deploy a build to a host with a backup and config test, verified by a post-deploy health check. Server-mutating steps are --approve-gated.
blocks.verify_summary: navig health reports the host healthy after the restart
blocks.install: navig apply safe-deployment --input host=... --input build_dir=... --approve backup --approve upload --approve permissions --approve restart

blocks.description: Export a remote database and pull it to the workspace; the verified outcome is a local dump file that exists.
blocks.verify_summary: the downloaded dump file exists under local_dir
blocks.install: navig apply db-snapshot --input host=... --input db_name=... --approve dump --approve cleanup

blocks.description: Publish an app to the Microsoft Store — upload a built MSIX and commit a submission via a pre-authenticated Microsoft Store Developer CLI (msstore). The Microsoft-Store analogue of steam-build-upload.
blocks.verify_summary: msstore submission status reports the submission after commit
blocks.install: navig apply msstore-publish --input product_id=... --input package_path=... --approve publish
